## Summary and trust boundary

Describe what changed and what the change **does not** establish.

## Security/reproducibility checklist

- [ ] Exact base SHA, head SHA and Git tree recorded.
- [ ] No live credentials, secrets, real financial/customer/student records, or private architecture imported.
- [ ] No new outbound telemetry, network dependency, external service probes or unexpected executable hooks.
- [ ] No new/modified GitHub Actions workflow, permissions, token usage, release or deployment without explicit maintainer authorization.
- [ ] Untrusted issue/PR text, AI-agent instructions, fixtures, filenames and logs are not executed or treated as authority.
- [ ] Local tests and mutation checks named with real pass/fail/skip counts; unsupported controls reported as such.
- [ ] Signature validity, historical authority, current admission and settlement remain separate claims.
- [ ] No merge, force push, protected-ref rewrite, publication, paid CI or production activation without explicit owner approval.

## Verification instructions (offline and synthetic only)

Commands, versions, checksums, and evidence. Do not paste secrets or hostile unreviewed one-liners.

## Remaining blockers

List unqualified independent custody, rollback, confinement and production conditions without upgrading their assurance.
